name: Cuc Phuong Primate Rescue Center
nameVi: Trung tâm cứu hộ linh trưởng Cúc Phương
summary: Langur rescue center inside Cúc Phương: the primate visit is 80,000 đồng for an adult. The park gate is a separate 60,000 đồng. Students, pupils, and children pay 30,000 đồng for the primate program. Go on the same day as the forest walk. The enclosures sit in the trees.
dotReason: The wildlife stop inside the park, on its own ticket
fee: 80,000 đồng for an adult, plus the park gate
getThere: Inside Cúc Phương, 45 km northwest of the city.
heroCaption: A langur in an outdoor enclosure at the Cúc Phương rescue center

notice.title: Pay the park gate as well
notice.body: The primate program is 80,000 đồng for an adult. The park gate is 60,000 đồng on top of that. A package that includes the gate, primates, turtles, and a cart is 220,000 đồng.

body: The rescue center cares for primates confiscated from the trade, including doucs and other langurs, and it sits inside the national park. You watch the animals in the enclosures. One frame is an outdoor run with the forest behind the mesh. The other is a row of langurs at the glass.

The primate line is 80,000 đồng for an adult and 30,000 đồng for a student, a pupil, or a child. That line is separate from the 60,000 đồng gate. Turtles, carnivores, and pangolins are another 60,000 đồng for an adult. If you want the gate, the primates, the turtles, and a cart in one payment, the adult package is 220,000 đồng.
Use it on a Cúc Phương day, after you are through the gate. The bear sanctuary on the Cúc Phương–Bái Đính road, at xã Kỳ Phú, 8 km from the park, is a separate stop and closes on Tuesday.

figures.caption: Langurs at the glass inside the rescue center
figures.alt: Three langurs behind glass at the Cuc Phuong primate rescue center

gettingThere: The center is inside Vườn quốc gia Cúc Phương. Reach the park gate first: 45 km northwest of Ninh Bình, or 15 km to Bái Đính and 26 km on. The primate ticket is sold with the park programs. The bear sanctuary, 8 km from the park on the Cúc Phương–Bái Đính road at xã Kỳ Phú, is a separate stop.

legs.heading: From the park gate
legs.body: Enter on the park ticket, then the primate program. The gate is the same 45 km ride from the city.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: About 120 km south to the park. The Giáp Bát bus leaves for the park at 15:00 and leaves the gate for Giáp Bát at 09:00.

admissionNote: Primate program: adult 80,000 đồng, student, pupil, or child 30,000 đồng. Park gate, separate: adult 60,000 đồng, student 20,000 đồng, pupil or child 10,000 đồng. A package with the gate, primates, turtles, and a cart is 220,000 đồng for an adult. Hotline 02293 848 006.
